name: tesserabx-pm
author: OIS Technologies
shortDescription: Project Management add-on for the TesseraBX helpdesk platform.
description: A third-party TesseraBX add-on. Adds projects, tasks, subtasks, customizable kanban boards, time tracking, templates, per-project custom fields, bidirectional ticket integration, mentions, watchers, a client-portal surface, and pgvector-backed AI augmentation through the host's AI middleware. Installs at modules/tesserabx-pm/ and participates in the host's settings.tesserabx manifest contract.
instructions: After install run `box run-script migrate:stage && box run-script migrate:up` from the TesseraBX host repo root to land PM's schema. PM mounts itself into the host via the settings.tesserabx manifest contract; no additional configuration is required.
_buildNote: PM does not run its own server. Dependency pins mirror the TesseraBX host's box.json so contributors who run `box install` against this repo for standalone introspection resolve compatible artifacts; at runtime PM uses whatever the host has installed.
